name: OpenMontage Drama Studio
description: Self-hostable AI short-drama workshop: script → cast → storyboard → shots → voice → edit. Bring your own LLM / Seedream / Seedance keys.

STUDIO_DEMO_ENABLED.description: Enable one-click Demo login (recommended for first boot).

STUDIO_DEMO_AUTO_ENTER.description: Skip the login screen and enter Demo automatically.

STUDIO_GOOGLE_ENABLED.description: Show Google sign-in (needs API_BASE_URL / OAuth client).

STUDIO_REQUIRE_GITHUB_STAR.description: Require starring the GitHub repo before generate (hosted demo only).

STUDIO_FREE_FIRST.description: Prefer free LLM / image providers when configured.

STUDIO_IMAGE_BACKEND.description: Image backend: auto | nvidia | seedream | comfyui | …

UVICORN_WORKERS.description: API worker processes (1–2 on Basic dynos).

STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of this app after deploy (e.g. https://YOURAPP.herokuapp.com). Set after first boot if CORS looks wrong.

STUDIO_DEMO_SECRET.description: Optional HMAC secret for Demo tokens (set a long random string in production).

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.description: Optional DeepSeek key for scripts (or configure keys in the UI later).

VOLCENGINE_API_KEY.description: Optional Volcengine Ark key (Seedream images + Seedance video).

ARK_API_KEY.description: Alias for VOLCENGINE_API_KEY if you use that name.

COMFYUI_SERVER_URL.description: Optional public ComfyUI URL for self-hosted image/video.
